analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, ADX 추세 강도 유지

analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어나고 있으나, 여전히 52주 저가 부근인 69,540원 수준에서 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 이른 시점. ADX 30.5로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 지속 가능성.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is exiting oversold territory but still consolidating around the 52-week low of 69,540 KRW. MACD histogram shows improvement but it's too early to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 30.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is still above +DI, suggesting continued downward pressure.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 37.4로 약세 구간, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 음수 유지. 일봉 RSI 과매도 탈출 신호와 충돌.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 37.4 remains in weak territory, and weekly MACD histogram stays negative, conflicting with the daily RSI signal of exiting oversold.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (69,540 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (72,760 KRW / 82,606 KRW / 97,768 KRW): below short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Position vs SMA100/200 (123,502 KRW / 112,845 KRW): below long-term trend, in weak territory
· 52-week position (14.8%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.4 → 37.8): exiting oversold territory, weak upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2825.4509 → 449.8475): improving, in weak convergence zone
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower 48,414 KRW, Middle 82,606 KRW): approaching lower band, wide band width at 82.78%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (68,045 KRW): above 5-day low, potential for recovery signal
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): potential for short-term rebound if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): potential recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.54): low confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation

MACD histogram continues to improve, expect trend reversal upon crossing above 0.

analysis.riskNote: 주봉 RSI 약세 구간 및 주봉 MACD 음수 유지로 인한 일봉 반등의 지속성 불확실성.
